episode_summary: In this episode, Natalie Taflinger shares her strategies for preparing homes for listing by offering solutions rather than just recommendations. She emphasizes the importance of setting realistic pricing expectations using data and highlights the value of community involvement for organic lead generation. Natalie's approach is centered on transparency, credibility, and leveraging personal passions to grow her real estate business.
